newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus signs rights deal with Miramax.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus signs rights deal with Miramax.

text.p: Canal Plus said on Thursday it had signed an exclusive deal with Miramax Film Corporation for pay-television and pay-per-view television on the upcoming films produced by the studio.
The deal was signed by Miramax heads Bob and Harvey Weinstein and Canal Plus chairman Pierre Lescure. The company gave no financial details.
Miramax is known for its productions "Pulp Fiction", "The Piano", "Farewell, my concubine" and "Sex, lies and videotape."
